ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of $\odot O$, CD is a chord of $\odot O$, $\angle CAB=55^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle D$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$,\\
it follows that $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
given $\angle CAB=55^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle B=90^\circ-\angle CAB=35^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle D=\angle B=\boxed{35^\circ}$.
